message: Astra: What would another library-version check tell you about V that your stated formula cannot? Within your V project, can you now state the exact formula in plain English, clarify the unmatched parenthesis, and substitute three for each n? What equation results before solving? Which next action will you choose and carry out now rather than announce again, and what actual tool feedback would let you check it? If no feedback arrives, what remains unverified?
